beats.text: Standard RAG models harbor a dirty secret. Feed them garbage search results. They hallucinate errors with absolute confidence.
beats.visual_focus: A glowing retrieval stream feeding noisy red document fragments into a transformer core, which erupts with red hallucination warnings.

beats.text: Standard retrievers act like blind couriers. They dump flawed. Noisy documents directly into your prompt. Leaving the model helpless against hallucinations.
beats.visual_focus: A robotic courier blindly tossing fragmented, corrupted index files across an unchecked conveyor belt into a language model context window.

beats.text: Enter CRAG. Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation. It installs an active referee right between the document retriever and your generation model.
beats.visual_focus: A glowing emerald gatekeeper appears along the data bus, freezing incoming document packets for rapid diagnostic evaluation.
